entries.title: Suggestions stay with the active writing field
entries.summary: When Cotabby recovers a missing text field, it now checks that the field is focused in the current window. Suggestion popups move above the cursor when there is too little room below.
entries.why: Switching windows is less likely to leave a suggestion attached to an old field, and the popup stays on screen.

technical.notes: Recovery validates actual focus and current-window membership with bounded ancestry traversal. Renderer subprocesses remain supported without relying only on process IDs.

points: Recognizes the exact Slack, Element, and Ferdium app identities for field recovery.
details: Signed development build; focus policy, app identity, and popup geometry tests pass. The three messaging apps are not installed for live testing.
This still needs ordinary use testing.
entries.noPicture: No safe saved app-only capture was available; inspected Computer Use images could not be exported, and private whole-screen captures were discarded.
entries.headline: Suggestions that respect your words

entries.title: Corrections and familiar phrases keep surrounding text intact
entries.summary: Accented letters and emoji no longer make typo corrections delete extra characters. Familiar phrase suggestions also avoid repeating text already below the cursor.
entries.why: Accepting a suggestion keeps the words you already wrote and avoids duplicate sign-offs.

technical.notes: Focused coordinator, history, Unicode, and insertion tests pass. An AppKit NSTextView probe preserves preceding text for decomposed accents, joined emoji, and flags.

points: Phrase suggestions obey their word limit even after a complete first word.
Unsafe history matches fall back to the selected completion engine.
details: Signed development build; regression checks and native text-deletion probe passed, everyday-app checks remain.
This still needs ordinary use testing.
entries.noPicture: Native UI could be inspected but no clean app-only image could be saved without including unrelated private windows.
entries.headline: Suggestions that respect your words

entries.title: Cotabby remembers the words you choose
entries.summary: Save names and specialist words in Writing settings. Cotabby preserves their spelling and can finish an unambiguous word prefix.
entries.why: Your project names and unusual surnames stop being treated as typos.

technical.notes: 317 focused regression tests pass. Native UI add, duplicate, remove, re-add, and pane-reopen persistence checks pass.

points: Add or remove individual words, or clear the list.
The vocabulary list stays local and is not added to AI requests.
details: Signed development build; vocabulary controls verified in the app, system-wide typing checks in progress.
This still needs ordinary use testing.
entries.noPicture: Native UI was inspected through Computer Use, but a clean app-only capture could not be saved. Whole-screen captures contained unrelated private windows and were discarded.
entries.headline: Suggestions that respect your words
entries.intro: This development build adds a personal word list and fixes cases where suggestions could repeat or replace the wrong text.

upcoming.title: Verify suggestions in everyday apps
upcoming.summary: Accessibility is enabled for Cotabby Dev. Input Monitoring is approved but macOS still requires user authentication. Global typing and the uninstalled Slack, Element, and Ferdium apps remain to be verified.

upcoming.title: Preserve capitalization in familiar phrases
upcoming.summary: The existing history predictor can change a familiar phrase after the same word is typed with different capitalization elsewhere. It needs phrase-specific spelling storage.

upcoming.title: Keep large context requests within Apple Intelligence limits
upcoming.summary: The existing Apple engine limits context sources individually but lacks a combined budget. Large multilingual notes and surrounding text can still exceed its request limit.
